edges.notes: Portable services are implemented and operated by the systemd suite on Linux.
Attached portable images ship unit files consumed by the standard systemd unit model.
Portable images rely on Linux mount, loop, and optional verity behaviors per documentation.
Substitutable packaging model for running services on a Linux host; OCI vs portable image differs.
Portable OS-tree bundles vs OCI image layers address similar delivery goals with different formats and runtimes.
Both extend the host OS tree under systemd; sysext merges /usr-style hierarchies while portablectl attaches portable service profiles per distinct manuals.
Portable services and confext both layer host-visible trees; confext uses overlay merge for /etc-class paths per systemd-confext manuals.
